summary.answer: Source-visible answer: preinit invocation body; suppresses calls after predone becomes true; no unconditional once-only guarantee exists during a yielding/reentrant prefunc, invokes prefunc synchronously and sets predone AFTER the body (114-115) - mirror-image of the post side where postdone is set before. Dependency behavior: requirement threading via function_8dfa23e0 with no join (109-112); ignore/undefined records skipped (102-105). Reached only from run_pre_systems (152) and the requirement resolver (132/139); no external caller exists in the corpus. Pre phase sets NO completion flag (run_pre_systems 147-154 has no flagsys::set) - the first observable signal is only at post phase (system_init_complete); so a script cannot source-visibly wait for 'preinit finished' - only for 'post phase done'. HMH linkage: wz-relevant preinits observed via mp_common/callbacks.gsc set_default_callbacks (65-98, installs level callback pointers consumed by g3's delivery units) and the hashed map systems' prefuncs (e.g. script_34e49e82e2f499e1 __init__ threads init_switch/function_920f9a6/function_624de77b 33-38); wz main itself is not a system prefunc - it is an event handler with relative order to this phase unproven.
summary.behavior: Preinit invocation executor. exec_pre_system(func): returns when record undefined or func.ignore set (102-105); if !func.predone: if func.reqs defined call function_8dfa23e0(func) (109-112), then synchronously invoke [[func.prefunc]]() and only then set func.predone=1 (114-115). predone-after-body means a prefunc is fully executed before its record is marked done; predone is only set after prefunc returns; successful prior completion suppresses later calls, but no in-progress guard excludes reentrancy or another call while prefunc yields; VM scheduling remains unknown. All entry paths spawn: run_pre_systems threads it per registry entry (system_shared.csc 152) and function_8dfa23e0 threads it per requirement (132, 139); there is no synchronous exec_pre_system call site in the corpus. The prefunc bodies observed in the wz-relevant set perform pointer/table installs and thread workers (mp_common/callbacks.gsc set_default_callbacks 65-98; script_34e49e82e2f499e1.gsc __init__ 33-38). summary.answer: Source-visible answer: registration is state-only (no invocation); when an existing record has ignore=1, every repeated register call asserts that ignore flag and returns without clearing it; the record may be a placeholder or a previously real record marked by ignore (register assert only on .ignore, csc 11-15; ignore() sets ignore=1, csc 169-179). Ordering graph produced (see source_trace): autoexec __init__system__ -> register -> native level_preinit -> codecallback_preinitialization -> run_pre_systems -> exec_pre_system per entry; native level_finalizeinit -> codecallback_finalizeinitialization -> run_post_systems -> exec_post_system per entry -> set system_init_complete -> registry cleared -> on_finalize_initialization dispatch. Dependency waits: NONE - req-resolution spawns threads without joining (69/76), the only synchronization is the whole-batch flag "system_init_complete" (92) consumed by wait_till (162). Error behavior: all failures are assert() with dev strings; retail evaluation of assert is a native/build fact. HMH root/registrant linkage: the HMH map script wz_open_skyscrapers.gsc::main joins this mechanism by load::main -> system::wait_till("all") (wz_open_skyscrapers.gsc 53; load.gsc 35) and by callback::on_finalize_initialization registration (47) delivered inside codecallback_finalizeinitialization after run_post_systems; the mechanism therefore conditions the whole HMH map startup; the exact set of registrant systems loaded into the HMH server VM is the unresolved native bundle boundary (m1 unknowns #1).
summary.behavior: Registration store for the per-VM system registry; server file lines 9-29 and client twin lines 9-29 are textually identical at this revision. register(str_name, func_preinit, func_postinit, reqs): if level.system_funcs[str_name] already exists it asserts the existing record's .ignore and returns WITHOUT replacing the stored prefunc/postfunc/reqs (csc/gsc 11-15) - repeated regular registration is an assert boundary; any existing ignore-flagged record, including a real record later marked by ignore, permits repeated early returns; ignore remains set. Otherwise it lazily creates level.system_funcs, stores a spawnstruct with prefunc/postfunc/reqs and initializes predone=!isdefined(func_preinit), postdone=!isdefined(func_postinit), ignore=0 (17-28). No execution happens here; the record is pure state consumed by exec_pre/exec_post_system. The following are named source registration witnesses, not a corpus-wide count or proof of the actual retail HMH registrant set; conditional server-source examples: mp_common/callbacks.gsc autoexec __init__system__ registers "callback" preinit &__init__ (23-26) whose preinit installs level.callbackplayerconnect etc. via set_default_callbacks (65-98); util_shared.gsc registers "util_shared" pre &__init__ post &__main__ (21-24); the four hashed systems #using-imported by wz_open_skyscrapers.gsc register hash_18ce058ad321248f (script_34e49e82e2f499e1.gsc 13-16), hash_32ef71953f1186eb (script_5f3e7d348fbc5283.gsc 10-13), hash_280fe2667ed2d300 with reqs #"item_supply_drop" (script_71e26f08f03b7a7a.gsc 12-15), hash_502d65acd9829223 (script_7611295950bc2c87.gsc 10-13); killstreak systems that wz later ignores register with reqs (killstreaks/mp/supplydrop.gsc 44 and uav.gsc 28, req #"killstreaks").
